phase 68 validation
===================

implemented
-----------
- versioned external corpus manifests under bench/corpora/
- manifest-aware fetch helper: tools/fetch_phase68_corpora.py
- manifest-aware benchmark runner: tools/run_phase68_public.py
- optional miniz integration in bench/bench_phase68_public.c and CMake
- local smoke manifest + files for offline CTest coverage

validated locally
-----------------
- release configure/build: ok
- release targeted tests: ok
- release runner smoke on local manifest: ok
- Werror configure/build: ok
- Werror targeted tests: ok

notes
-----
- public benchmark currently links against local zlib runtime 1.3.1 in this container.
- official zlib upstream current release is 1.3.2 (see docs/source references).
- optional miniz comparator wiring was added, but this environment did not provide miniz headers/sources,
  so the miniz path is compiled as unavailable rather than validated live.
